payload.core_mechanism_summary: Enumerates all candidates with Hamming distance b from first guess by flipping b bit positions, then filters by checking popcount(x xor guess_i) == b_i.
payload.rationale: Uses itertools.combinations to select bit positions to flip, generating a candidate set via bitwise XOR, then applies iterative filtering with substring popcount. This is a complete search over bitmask combinations.
